name: disciple_fellowship_of_leaves
description: a Disciple of the Fellowship of Leaves, a young druid novice with brown hair under a green hood covered in bright green leaves, a mantle of leaves over his shoulders, a long green coat with light green trim over a brown tunic, a brown belt with a silver buckle and a pouch, brown boots, and a gnarled sprouting wooden staff with green leaves at its top in his LEFT hand; his RIGHT hand is an empty fist
hands: the leafy wooden staff stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left inside the leafy hood, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the staff arm thrown up and out with the leafy wooden staff)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the leafy wooden staff tilting forward to the right, the empty fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up with the leafy wooden staff, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the leafy hood droops, the wooden staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the leafy wooden staff slanting down with one end resting on the ground in front of him, the empty arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the leafy wooden staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the leafy wooden staff lies on the ground at the lower-right; the green leaf-covered coat spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, a few loose leaves settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed under the leafy hood, the leafy wooden staff on the ground beside him
